text:
Today, DEP announced a groundbreaking partnership with @Sysco that will create opportunities for a significant expansion of the state’s successful program that uses seafood shells recycled from restaurants for creation of oyster reefs. The reefs can improve the ecological health of coastal waters, reduce waste to landfills, enhance climate resilience and benefit local restaurants.

The collaboration, announced during a news conference and tour of Sysco’s @BuckheadNewport Meat and Seafood processing facility in Lakewood, Ocean County, builds on the company’s similar efforts elsewhere to restore oyster reefs, which can play an important role in maintaining and enhancing healthy coastal ecosystems.
